Preflight Demo Program
DOC-0010 2026-10-15
Task Labels, Subsystem Labels, and Blank Fields
Desk reference dated 2026-10-15 Prepared by Demo Worker 0001 for Demo
Team 01
TASK STATUS — exact spellings
todo: The task's queued category. Do not substitute the issue term open.
in_progress: The task workflow category for activity underway. Specify task
when the same wording might be read as an issue field.
awaiting_review: The task review category. Its completion timestamp is
empty. A booked conversation is not evidence of this value.
completed: The task completion category. Its completion timestamp is
populated. This value does not automatically give the parent issue the status
closed.
blocked: The task category for an impediment in its tracking workflow. A
paper reminder is not evidence that this value applies.
TASK KIND — separate from status
review: A category label for review-related tracking.
investigation: A category label for investigation-related tracking.
documentation: A category label for documentation-related tracking.
inspection: A category label preserved from the task vocabulary.
rectification: A category label preserved from the task vocabulary.
These terms identify entries for coordination. None supplies a physical
procedure, a completion claim, or a reason to change another field. Put the
kind in the kind box and the question in the question box.
SUBSYSTEM — issue grouping labels
hydraulics: Use this exact grouping word.
avionics: Use this exact grouping word.
electrical: Keep distinct from avionics.
cabin: Use the recorded grouping, not a guessed alternative.
structures: Retain the plural spelling.
D. Worker 0001
Demo Worker 0001, Demo Team 01

Preflight Demo Program
DOC-0010 2026-10-15
controls: Retain the plural spelling.
A task kind and a subsystem describe different fields. A subject heading may
mention both, but the routing slip must keep them separate so a coordinator
can ask for the intended grouping.
ISSUE AND PRIORITY REMINDER
open, in_progress, blocked, reopened, closed are issue statuses. Unresolved
means any issue status other than closed. A reopened issue has closure then
reopening history and an empty current closure timestamp.
low, medium, high are priority labels. They do not describe task kind or
substitute for an issue status.
BLANKS AND REFERENCES
assigned_person_id left blank: No person assignment is recorded in that field.
Do not fill the gap with the meeting recorder's name. An assigned person,
when present, belongs to the task's assigned team.
A question using ISSUE-0011, DEMO-AIR-0006, or TASK-0080 still needs a
correspondence recipient. This sheet does not supply that recipient.
Editing note: Read underscores aloud as part of the field spelling when
dictating a correction; preserve the exact written label.
D. Worker 0007
Demo Worker 0001, Demo Team 01
